verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase is a built-in natural-language chat assistant in the Firebase console. It answers product questions and generates code. It also generates schemas, queries and mutations on demand, analyzes crashes and logs with root-cause and fix suggestions, and summarizes messaging campaigns with recommendations. The MCP server serves external agents, not the built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence that the assistant autonomously executes multi-step actions in the project (its documented outputs are mostly advisory or generated artifacts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
